subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do maintainers accept executing these 14 new action commits in workflows that receive application private keys, API keys, registry credentials, write tokens, and security-scanning permissions?
rationale: The patch has no concrete correctness defect, but CI cannot decide whether the repository accepts the new third-party executable code at these privileged trust boundaries.

options.title: Accept after exact-head validation
options.body: Review the sensitive upstream deltas, refresh onto current `main`, and merge after all required checks pass on the resulting head.

options.title: Split privileged action updates
options.body: Separate Codex, token-generation, Docker-publishing, and CodeQL changes into smaller PRs for narrower security review.

options.title: Pause the grouped refresh
options.body: Leave the current pins in place until maintainers are ready to review the grouped supply-chain change.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head validation
recommendation.body: Review the sensitive upstream deltas, refresh onto current `main`, and merge after all required checks pass on the resulting head.

likelyOwner.reason: The history connects this person to both the agent workflows and broad release/Actions modernization affected by the decision.
